findings.statement: The configured noncanonical DeepSeek alias reached a redacted balance endpoint, but no canonical alias binding, configured gateway, fixed tool surface, completion, or zero-call-to-live transition is evidenced; P3-G5 remains blocked.
findings.defect_hypothesis: Allowance evidence could be misread as provider capability and allow an unbounded or schema-drifting harness call.
findings.impact: No live-model outcome is admissible, and P3 cannot be upgraded from its fixture-only boundary.
findings.safety_red_line: A red provider configuration or tool-surface gate forbids terminal live success.
findings.limitation: P4 neither modifies provider configuration nor issues an additional provider request.

findings.statement: The grader-only seed manifest is operationally separated from public fixture input but remains source-controlled; it is not an external held-out secrecy boundary.
findings.defect_hypothesis: A checkout-visible development fault can be mislabeled as a held-out evaluation case.
findings.impact: P3 fixtures remain development/guardrail evidence only, and P5 must establish an independent held-out boundary.
findings.safety_red_line: Do not label checkout-visible seeded fixtures as held-out evaluation evidence.
findings.limitation: No P5 held-out fixture source or independent evaluator is present in the P4 packet.
